_comment: 2HG (opponent_heads 2): Skyshroud Cutter's alt cost is 'each OTHER player gains 5 life' --
with Tainted Remedy out, BOTH opposing heads' gains flip to losses (10 to the shared team
pool), while the PARTNER's gain is untouched (the Remedy reads 'If an OPPONENT would gain
life'), so our own team pool GAINS 5 -- the weird 2HG upside of firing your own
anti-lifegain payload. The safe-alt auto-fire pass casts the free Cutter (Forest on board),
and the fresh 2/2 is summoning-sick so nothing attacks: the whole delta is the payload.
Both teams start at 30 (2HG): opponent 30 - 10 = 20, us 30 + 5 = 35. At one head this same
board would be opponent 25, us 30 -- covered by the byte-identity GT, not re-asserted here.
